Container.Name: CraftControl-WebPanel
Container.Overview: CraftControl Centralized Web Panel Control Plane for Minecraft server & daemon node management.

Config.Name: Public Panel URL
Config.Description: The address users reach this panel on, e.g. https://retr0net.nl or http://192.168.50.220:3000. Used to build the links in verification and password-reset emails. Leave blank to derive it from the request, which works for direct access and behind a proxy that sets X-Forwarded-Host.

Config.Name: JWT Secret Token
Config.Description: Secret key used for signing user session JWT tokens

Config.Name: Web Panel Data Directory
Config.Description: Host folder mounted into the web panel container for persistent data or custom files

Config.Name: Discord Bot Shared Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret the standalone Discord bot authenticates with. Must match the same variable on the craftcontrol-discord-bot container. Left blank the integration is off and every bot command is rejected - which looks from Discord like a broken bot rather than a disabled feature.
